subject: Rollcall: budget owner, finance readiness & target $/1M tokens
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + quick rollcall: who signs, who approves finance?

Hi Alice — thanks for carving time today. Quick recap and the actions we agreed: 

1) Scope we discussed
- Real-time routing for conversational agents (summary, rerank).
- Expected steady-state text generation volume: 6–12M tokens/month; burst up to ~20M.

2) Pricing / economic target
- You mentioned a target price band, roughly $600–$700 per 1M tokens (target $/1M).
- Ballpark annual budget range you’re thinking: $300k–$900k (depending on contract/commit).

3) Decisions & procurement
- Please confirm the economic buyer (who signs commercial terms) and the finance contact who will handle PO/CC or SOW.
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly vs annual) and any internal procurement constraints (reqs for SOW, security attestation).

4) Next steps
- If you can confirm the budget range and the two names (econ buyer + procurement), we’ll produce a tailored quote and a 30/60/90 rollout pricing table by EOW.
- I attached a simple spend model (RFI_Spend_Model_v2.xlsx) to show unit economics at different token bands.

Thanks again — cc’ing Marissa (PM) and Dylan (CS lead) so we can align delivery expectations.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RFI_Spend_Model_v2.xlsx
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick rollcall: who signs, who approves finance?

Hi Karthik — great to chat, thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers below: 

- Token volumes: our best estimate today is 8–10M tokens/month in Q1 as we ramp, trending to 12–15M by mid-year if the pilot goes well. We can plan conservatively for 10M.

- Target price: yes, our procurement target is in the $600–$700 / 1M tokens range. Our CFO will push for the lower end, but we understand that committed volumes/term will move price.

- Budget: we have headroom in the FY27 AI Ops budget; ballpark available is $400k–$800k depending on contract shape (term, commit).

- Economic buyer (who signs): Jordan Patel, Head of AI Platforms (jordan.patel@acme.ai).
- Finance / procurement contact: Sandeep Rao (procurement@acme.ai) — he handles PO and legal routing. I can loop him if helpful.

Procurement cadence: prefer PO with net-30; SOW ok for initial pilot if Redwood prefers.

If you can send a pricing sketch (3-tier commit table + pilot terms), we’ll review and aim to get Jordan & Sandeep a single-thread summary for approvals.

Thanks — Alice
Director, Product — Acme AI

- Procurement contact Sandeep Rao (external) prefers PO + net-30; flag for legal re: PO terms.

- Dylan: please prepare a pilot pricing sketch (3 commit tiers: pilot 1–3M, growth 6–12M, enterprise 12M+) showing $/1M at each band and an example annualized cost at 10M/month. Attach Draft_SOW_PRICING.pdf for internal review — I attached an initial layout.
- Aisha (CC): can you run a quick check on standard PO vs SOW timeline for enterprise accounts and flag any blockers for a 60-day procurement window?
- Karthik: once Dylan has the sketch, let’s prep a one-page summary for Jordan + Sandeep with clear ask (approve pilot budget, sign PO or SOW).

Procurement estimate: plan for 45–60 days to get a PO in place if legal review is standard. If they go SOW + prepay, we can compress to ~30 days.
